notes.title: The Emma-Nellie Challenge Change Log
notes.content:
Test your Aqua Bike riding skills in our most challenging championship yet, the Emma-Nellie Challenge! Do you have what it takes to beat the world champion? 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25571963/930169ddf7e29e9daba9c2f0e6ce3cc2cedbcf09.jpg

In addition to the new bonus championship with five brand new tracks to compete in, there are many other interesting updates. Changes have been made to the missed buoys disqualification system to allow the first steps in competition to be smoother for newcomers including local split-screen play with friends and family. We have further expanded the roles of the boss characters in all of the three major single player campaigns, to reveal their personalities and how they feel if they get beaten by the player or if they stand tall and victorious in the finals! 

Expansion contents:

 All new championship featuring the World Champion pro rider Emma-Nellie Örtendahl
Emma-Nellies Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/emmannellie/
 5 new tracks available for all game modes 
Championship, time trial, custom race, local multiplayer, online multiplayer

Introducing storylines

 Players entering any of the three main campaigns, as well as the new Emma-Nellie Challenge, will now encounter the personality of each unique reigning champion. Fight your way through all of the cups to face them in the finals. 


Changes have been made to the missed buoy disqualification system to allow the game to be even more easily accessible for beginners

 The first cup in the Runabout and Ski division now allows for 6 misses before disqualifying the racer on the 7th miss. (Up from 2)
 All the subsequent cups in both divisions allows for 4 misses before disqualifying the racer on the 5th miss. (Up from 2)
 When setting up a custom game, players can now choose between 1 and 6 allowed misses before disqualification.
 Please note: No changes have been made to the time trial disqualification rules.

notes.title: Aqua Moto Racing Holiday Patch!
notes.content:
We're celebrating the holidays with a brand new patch. Expect smoother frame rates and an overall improved experience as we have put much effort on optimizations. Among the new features you'll find that we have added AI extras to fill up empty slots when racing online, so now you can start racing immediately while waiting for others to join.


Changelog:

- Smoother frame rate!
- Optimizations
- Simplified online matchmaking
- Nicer collisions in Online mode
- Fill-up AI opponents in online mode
- Bugfixes


Please enjoy, happy holidays from the Zordix Team!

notes.title: The Super Summer Patch!
notes.content:
Just in time for some vacation racing we are proud to release what we think is our best patch yet.

Besides numerous performance optimizations we have also added simplified “Easy Stunts” and optional WASD controls. Online game mode has a new more convenient auto-variation of tracks. 

We have also worked hard to improve the water interaction with the watercraft for a smoother experience. Collision handling has been tweaked to be more forgiving towards players. 

Details/Change log

 Performance optimizations
 Improved performance on low graphic settings
 Easy stunt - New simplified stunt functionality
 Added optional WASD controls
 Less aggressive AI
 Improved local multiplayer performance
 Tweaked collision handling
 Improved watercraft interaction with water
 Simplified track shuffle mode for online game hosting
 Invite a friend
 Updated Time trial medal times
 Tweaked shorelines
 A lot of minor bug fixes


Overall we hope you’ll have an improved experience. Enjoy the update!

/The Zordix Team

notes.title: Patch 5, X-mas Special
notes.content:
Its just before Xmas and Santa showed up in the night and silently programmed some changes into our game. We have surveillance footage!

Changes:

Doppler effects added. 
Reworked engine sounds
Changes in rider physics so you can parry waves better. Use your throttle to parry.
Smoother landings after big jumps.
Balance changes in championships, a bit more challenging, a bit more fun
Bugs, bugs, bugs squashed, killed and burned.


What Santa added:

AI:s are enabled in split-screen multiplay so you and your family can enjoy some competitions in style.
And he mumbled something about hats....


Happy Hollidays, join us in Utopia.

notes.title: Aqua Moto Racing Utopia leaves Early Access!
notes.content:
Aqua Moto Racing Utopia is coming out of the closet, making the change, opening the door to a new future. It has made the transition from Early Access to Full Release. We want to thank all you Steamers for the help with feedback to make it better and spreading the word. 

We will continue to support the game and there will be more things added later on. News on that will be released when it is time to do so.

At the same time we will be releasing Patch 5 for the game. We have been working on a lot of stuff inside the game this time. Some tech changes, stabilization and network related issues we have found. With this release we feel that we have a stable game which we can proudly sell at our full prize. In many ways we are more stable than many AAA games out there.

Release Notes

Graphic improvements
3 New “Mini Boss” AI characters
Bug fixes in Network Code
Fixes in AI way-finding
Fixes in split screen play modes


Boss Characters

Liza Drago, Italy 
A supreme stunt expert of unmatched driving skills who likes to be challenged. She is fearless and keeps up the speed even in narrow passages.
Nickname: The Dragon

Zhang Duck-hwan - Freestyle Division Champion
Zhang Duck-hwan, South Korea 
Knows how to put on a show. A true master when it comes to performing stunts. His name means ”integrity returns” i Korean, which is good as his opponents like to call him ”The Duck in the Air”. 
Nickname: The Duck

Andrew Rocket - Runabout Division Champion
Andrew Rocket, USA 
Loves high speed, and to activate the turbo speed boost. 
Nickname: The Rocket

notes.title: New release dates for Aqua Moto Racing Utopia
notes.content:
Because of, well, mostly clerical/marketing reasons, we will have to push our release of Aqua Moto Racing Utopia from the 22 to the 29-30.


In Europe the PS4 version will be released on the 30th.
In America the PS4 version will be released on the 29th.
Our Steam version will go from Early Access to Full release on the 30th.


We apologize and hope all our fans can stand another week in waiting.

notes.title: Patch 4, New Content
notes.content:
This time around we invite you to the North Sea, where huge waves rule supreme and Oil is pumped from ancient sediments deep under the sea bed. A whole new environment (Oil Rig) is added with sunsets, huge dark deep sea waves, and fantastic gameplay. This is so much fun that we decided to release it even though there is a slight visibility bug with our water tech.


We have also updated the rider animations. The rider now looks like he is riding hard, forcing the vehicle around the bends and react to waves. This also makes the first person mode even more vivid and action filled!

We have tweaked the physics even more. We turned up the fun-o-meter to eleven and released the untamed forces of speed.

We have tweaked the gameplay on stunt courses. Water stunts will now not renew the stunt-multiplicator. Only air stunts will do that.

We added two voice over voices to the game. More voices to come later.

Updated graphics on the Mediterranean. It has been completely reworked, and is now ready for your short action vacation.

Even more light settings has been added on all environments to get an atmosphere beyond reality, even closer to Utopia!

 Bugs, bugs and more bugs killed. Don't worry, we have plenty of spray left!

notes.title: New Patch (Patch 3)
notes.content:
Another day, another update. In our dark basement in northern Sweden where now are met by ice and frost in the mornings, we keep working on our game. This time we have changed lighting levels on most of our environments and improved steering and stunts.


We have worked on the lighting settings on all environments.
We have changed wave settings and behavior on some courses.
We have change water looks on some levels, more will be changed later.
We have stabilized the riders when riding in interactive waves, less wibbly-wobbly.
We have gotten rid of most of the cameras that clip through water.
installer installs Microsoft Visual C++ redistributables if needed.
Fast turn button is no longer needed for doing areal rotations, though rotation is faster if you use it.
Bugs, bugs bugs everywhere. They keep hiding, wee keep finding them.


More and more polish is added to the game every day as we keep getting closer and closer to release. Please give us your opinions!

notes.title: New Patch Out (Patch 2)
notes.content:
We have done huge changes in the structure of tournaments because of feedback from the community. Stunt courses are out of championships and put into a championship of their own, graphics have been redone and we have worked through buoy placement to get better racing.

7 new tracks!
1 New championship
1 Environment, swamplands, has been completely redone, now more lush, better water and better tree models.

New Server Multiplayer Function
Now calling out for friends over the vast darkness of Internet can be better heard. Set up a multiplayer server, go into single play while waiting and get messaged when someone enters your server! (We are quite pleased with that one!)

NOTES

1   Swamplands graphically completely redone. More lush, more living and more fun!
2   Stunt competitions taken out of single player championship as per request from the community.
3   Stunt added as an own championship, you will now stunt of your own free will!
4   Added seven tracks to play in championship in stead of the stunt tracks. (mo game for the money)
6   Better working net code
7   Added functions to lobby. You can now set up a server, start playing a single player game and when someone enters the lobby you get a message in your game so you can join.
8   Our bug hunters found some critters and put them down, many are the trophies of strange creatures hanging over our mantle piece.
9   Respawn button. If you get lost, hold Y (on controller) and get respawn to the track.
10   More AI tweaks for your enjoyment. Less murderous, a bit smarter, a bit better.

notes.title: New Patch Out
notes.content:
​Patch Notes:

We hired a psychologist to talk to our Ai:s about their childhood and other important events in their life. They are now less prone to attempt murder on you.

Our racing league secretariat was sent to math classes and are now more proficient in actually tally the tournament points.

Our team of interns where sent out on the courses to sandpaper everything so that more friction has been added everywhere. Bumping into things will slow you down more now, making it easier to catch up to the leader when he makes mistakes.

We gave AI some maps for some tracks so they could better find their way around! (Our HR needs some better hiring practices)

When starting a run you will get some boost if you hit your throttle at the exact time you see the word “go” on your screen.

We had a talk to God and asked him to actually put the physics where our eyes saw actual things. This way we got less bruises from falling off for no apparent reason.

The Duckling mama mode was given a larger arena to compete in. (The Duckling mama sports association was loudly protesting the bad treatment of the up and coming extreme sport)

We found a valve in the basement marked “graphical quality” that was closed. We turned it on! (It was a red valve)

Polish and Russian languages added.

We sent our graphics department to the art museum and they came back with some new ideas for the graphics.

We called the exterminator and he put down some poison and we killed some more bugs!
